features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.effect: AC = 10 + DEX mod + WIS mod while wearing no armor and no shield.

features.name: Martial Arts
features.effect: Use DEX instead of STR for unarmed strikes/monk weapons; roll the Martial Arts die instead of normal damage; bonus-action unarmed strike after the Attack action.

features.name: Ki
features.effect: Ki points = monk level. Ki save DC = 8 + proficiency + WIS mod. Fuels Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind.

features.name: Flurry of Blows
features.effect: 1 ki: two unarmed strikes as a bonus action right after the Attack action.

features.name: Patient Defense
features.effect: 1 ki: Dodge as a bonus action.

features.name: Step of the Wind
features.effect: 1 ki: Disengage or Dash as a bonus action; jump distance doubled that turn.

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.effect: +10 ft speed while unarmored (already folded into Speed above).

features.name: Dedicated Weapon
features.effect: Touch a weapon after a rest to treat it as a monk weapon until swapped.

features.name: Deflect Missiles
features.effect: Reaction on a ranged hit: reduce damage by 1d10 + DEX mod + monk level; if reduced to 0, catch it and spend 1 ki to fire it back.

features.name: Ki-Fueled Attack
features.effect: Spend 1+ ki on your turn for a bonus-action unarmed/monk-weapon attack.

features.name: Shadow Arts
features.effect: 2 ki: cast Darkness, Darkvision, Pass without Trace, or Silence, no material components. Also grants the Minor Illusion cantrip.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.effect: +2 to one score or +1 to two, capped at 20. (Applied.)

features.name: Slow Fall
features.effect: Reaction when falling: reduce fall damage by 5 x monk level.

features.name: Quickened Healing
features.effect: Action + 2 ki: roll the Martial Arts die + proficiency bonus in healing.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.effect: Attack twice, not once, whenever taking the Attack action.

features.name: Stunning Strike
features.effect: 1 ki on a melee hit: target makes a CON save or is stunned until the end of Nathan's next turn.

features.name: Focused Aim
features.effect: After a miss, spend 1-3 ki for +2 to that attack roll per ki spent.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.effect: In dim light/darkness, bonus action to teleport 60 ft to a dim/dark space you can see; advantage on the first melee attack you make that turn.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.effect: In dim light/darkness, action to turn invisible until you attack, cast a spell, or enter bright light.

features.name: Opportunist
features.effect: Reaction: melee attack a creature within 5 ft when it's hit by an attack from someone other than you.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.effect: Cantrip, granted free by Shadow Arts. Cast at will, no ki cost.

spells.name: Darkness
spells.effect: 2 ki (Shadow Arts): cast Darkness, no material components.

spells.name: Darkvision
spells.effect: 2 ki (Shadow Arts): cast Darkvision, no material components.

spells.name: Pass without Trace
spells.effect: 2 ki (Shadow Arts): cast Pass without Trace, no material components.

spells.name: Silence
spells.effect: 2 ki (Shadow Arts): cast Silence, no material components.

notes:
Per Moss’s dream (S10): saw his mother murdered by a figure resembling his father as a kid.

Confirmed (S10, via the pipe man’s orb): that father is Dr. Tombs. The rest of the party doesn’t know this yet.

Told Bingus (S9): not interested in "the wish" — wants revenge.

Multiclass leaning (next level-up): Sorcerer, Shadow Magic origin — story reasons win out over Warlock here, since an inherited bloodline (Eyes of the Dark, Strength of the Grave) fits a necromancer father better than a warlock's pact framing. Long-rest slots, so it doesn't pair with Ki as cleanly, but that's the tradeoff.

Backup if Sorcerer doesn't pan out: 2 levels of Fighter for Action Surge + Second Wind — barely dents Monk progression, zero stat investment.

Close-range spell picks (not just the Shadow Magic origin features): Shocking Grasp (cantrip, touch, melee spell attack, shuts down the target's reaction) and Poison Spray (cantrip, 10 ft, save-based backup for when Shocking Grasp whiffs) as the starting pair. Thunderwave (1st level, self-centered push) for when he's surrounded. Long-term goal once he's deeper into Sorcerer: Vampiric Touch (3rd level, melee spell attack, necrotic, heals him for half the damage dealt) — the real echo of Dr. Tombs' necromancy.
